components.description: O3DE RPM packaging spec (versioned package: o3de2610)

component.name: o3de2610
component.description: Open 3D Engine 26.10 line: real-time, multi-platform 3D engine. Built against the Stage-1 system-library swap set plus bundled Qt6 6.10.2 (reverted from system Qt6 2026-08-17: the bundled PySide6 needs upstream Qt's Qt_6_PRIVATE_API symbol, which Fedora's Qt6 does not provide; system Qt6 returns once PySide6 is rebuilt against it).

externalReferences.comment: Upstream engine source tarball (CycloneDX distribution for the engine component).
COPR stabilization channel (pre-release engine validation from upstream stabilization/26100).
COPR stable channel (broadest audience; tracks tagged upstream releases).

components.name: clang
components.description: Build dependency: the engine compiles with clang (-Werror).

components.name: qt6
components.description: Vanilla Qt 6.10.2 bundled by upstream O3DE (fetched via packages.o3de.org), no O3DE patches. Bundled Qt Bundling Library Exception is IN FORCE for the 26.10 line: the swap to Fedora's system qt6-qtbase (system_qt6 bcond, machinery retained default-off) is blocked by the bundled PySide6, which links this build's major-scoped libQt6Core.so.6(Qt_6_PRIVATE_API); Fedora's Qt6 exports only the minor-scoped Qt_6.11_PRIVATE_API. Exception resolves when PySide6 is rebuilt against system Qt6 (Option B).

components.name: o3de-system-library-swaps
components.description: Stage-1 system-library swaps active on the 26.10 line: bundled 3rdParty replaced by the Fedora system libs assimp, freetype, libpng, zlib, expat, lz4, openexr+imath, SQLite, lua, libsamplerate, google-benchmark, vulkan-validation-layers, mikkelsen. Each is a normal Fedora RPM dependency (auto-Requires the system soname); none are bundled.

components.name: o3de-dependencies
components.description: Fedora-clean COPR rebuilds of 3rdParty packages not (yet) in Fedora, consumed via hellaenergy/o3de-dependencies: o3de-dxc-spirv (license-clean SPIR-V-only DXC), o3de-mcpp-az, o3de-spirv-cross, o3de-cityhash. Shared with the 26.05 line (identical 3rdParty versions).

components.name: pyside6
components.description: PySide6 + shiboken6 bundled (fetched via packages.o3de.org): runtime-only Qt-for-Python bindings built against the engine's bundled CPython 3.10 AND the bundled Qt 6.10.2. Two walls block substitution: (1) Fedora python3-pyside6 is built for python3.13 (Python-C-module-ABI wall, same as OIIO/OCIO); (2) it links the bundled Qt's major-scoped libQt6Core.so.6(Qt_6_PRIVATE_API), which Fedora's Qt6 does not provide (it minor-scopes to Qt_6.11_PRIVATE_API) -- this is why the build ships bundled Qt6 rather than system Qt6. Powers the QtForPython gem + DccScriptingInterface. Substitutes after PySide6 is rebuilt against system Qt6 + system Python (FEDORA_ROADMAP stage 3 / Option B).

components.name: openssl
components.description: Bundled by upstream O3DE via packages.o3de.org. END-OF-LIFE since 2023-09-11. Migration to system OpenSSL 3.x is tracked in FEDORA_ROADMAP.md (stage 4); 3p #387 bumped the bundle to 3.6.3 upstream, engine-side pin bump pending.

components.name: o3de-clang-toolchain
components.description: Embedded clang/libclang/libtinfo bundled by O3DE (used by the DXC rebuild)

components.name: o3de-python
components.description: Bundled Python 3.10 venv installed by /opt/O3DE/<DISPLAY_VERSION>/python/get_python.sh into ~/.o3de/Python/venv/<engine-id>. System-Python migration (Fedora 3.13) tracked in FEDORA_ROADMAP stage 3; also gates a system PySide6 swap.
